record.field: List the printable reports (invoices, quotations, delivery slips...) that can be read with render_report, optionally for one model such as account.move. Each entry gives the technical "report" name to pass to render_report, its label and its model.

Render a report listed by list_reports for up to 10 records of its model, given by ID, and return the printed document as plain text, with "pdf_url", a link to the PDF the user can open in a browser where they are logged in to Odoo. Give the link to the user when they ask for the document itself. Long documents are cut, and "truncated" tells so: render fewer records at a time.
